name: 02169 · Quincy, MA
findings: ZIP 02169 (Quincy) has 206 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02169 (Quincy) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02169 (Quincy) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
